title: EmptyUsername variant has no test coverage
description: CredentialStoreError::EmptyUsername was added in commit 6d06d8e but there is no test that exercises it. The input ':somehash' (colon-prefixed, empty username field) should return EmptyUsername but the only malformed-line test passes 'nocolon' which hits MalformedLine instead. Regression risk: a future refactor could silently change the branch to emit MalformedLine for empty-username and no test would catch it.
